messages:
katie_w: Heads-up: nightly SAST started failing in a couple repos. Quick glance shows `KMS_DECRYPT_FAILED` in CI logs. Opening thread to coordinate a short checklist.
raj: Error shows `permission denied` for `serviceAccount:scanner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. Did anyone touch keystore RBAC?
mikko: I ran the scheduled rotation at 01:50 UTC and promoted a new key version. I may have missed reapplying the scanner binding to the new cryptoKey resource.
ops-bot: alert: nightly-sast failure (repo: infra-auth). Error tag: `KMS_DECRYPT_FAILED`. Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/logs/query?snapshot=...
devops: Fast mitigation: ephemeral grant of `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` to the scanner SA for 1 hour and re-run CI. Command example provided.
katie_w: Please ensure any grant is ephemeral and recorded in the incident ticket. We want an auditable trail, not permanent wide perms.
sec-oncall: Also add a Datadog log alert for `KMS_DECRYPT_FAILED` and route to #eng-oncall. Include runbook link.
raj: Short checklist proposal to add to runbooks page:
- Check CI log and note `principalEmail` + key resource.
- If principal == scanner SA -> ephemeral grant, re-run jobs, attach IAM diff to ticket.
- If error == NOT_FOUND -> contact rotation owner to check key/version.
- Post-incident: capture `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy` output and store in audit bucket.
mikko: I'm applying ephemeral binding now and will paste the policy diff once done.
ops-bot: event: policy-binding-created (actor: mikko)  role: cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter  member: scanner@redwood-prod  TTL: 1h
devops: I'll add CI automation to create a `SEC-` ticket on decrypt failures and attach logs.
katie_w: Thanks. After this incident let's add `infra/keystore/**` to CODEOWNERS -> @eng-security so keystore changes need review.
sec-oncall: I'll monitor and update the incident timeline. Close thread when runbook is posted.
